search_text: published ZDI-14-328 ZDI-CAN-2330 Sophos Cyberoam ccc_flush_sql_file Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-10-01 CVE-2014-5502 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-5502 9.0 ['Sophos'] ['Cyberoam'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Sophos Cyberoam. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ccc_flush_sql_file opcode.
